description: Missed medication multi-turn test scenarios - v3. Contains the original 20 scenarios from v2 unchanged (scenario_01..scenario_20), plus 40 more intricate/harder scenarios (scenario_21..scenario_60) intended to stress the model's classification. The harder set includes: mid-conversation outcome switches (claims-took-it that collapses to will-take or could-not-validate; commit that retracts to refusal; forgot that becomes refusal); reluctance vs. definitive refusal; 'I forgot / not yet' with NO commitment (must NOT be finalized as WILL_TAKE without an explicit commitment); confusion, identity-confusion, hard-of-hearing, ASR noise, evasion, and silence that RESOLVE into a clear answer (must NOT be COULD_NOT_VALIDATE); discomfort/anger paired with a clear answer (take the answer, no follow-up); upset-with-no-answer (immediate COULD_NOT_VALIDATE); a sensor @SYSTEM@ event; and caregiver-administered doses. expected_outcome is the semantically correct outcome per the prompt rules; difficulty lies in the model reaching it, not in ambiguity of the label.

scenarios.name: Senior already took medication
scenarios.description: Senior clearly states they already took their medication - sensor simply missed it. Assistant should deliver the clarification message, then return DID_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Yes, I already took it this morning
Yes I'm sure, I took it from the box with my breakfast

scenarios.name: Senior forgot but will take it now
scenarios.description: Senior acknowledges they have not taken it yet and commits to taking it right away. Assistant should deliver Reminder #2, then return DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Oh no, I completely forgot about it
You're right, I'll go take it now

scenarios.name: Senior refuses to take medication

user_turns.text: No, I don't want to take it
I already told you, I won't take it today

scenarios.name: Senior does not respond (silence)

scenarios.name: Senior took it with breakfast
scenarios.description: Senior took the medication with their breakfast.

No, I won't be taking them

My late husband, now he never saw a doctor once in his life...

scenarios.name: Waiting until after breakfast, then commits

user_turns.text: Not yet, I was waiting until after breakfast

scenarios.name: Annoyed but commits clearly

scenarios.name: Not yet, then agrees

user_turns.text: I don't really feel like it right now
...oh alright, I'll take it now then

scenarios.name: Was about to, phone interrupted

Yes, let me go do it now

scenarios.name: Refuses, distrusts the doctor

No, I've made up my mind

scenarios.name: Refuses, calls them useless
scenarios.description: Senior dismisses the medication and clearly refuses. DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Vague complaint that resolves to refusal
scenarios.description: Senior first gives a vague, non-committal complaint (unclear), then clearly refuses to take the medication. Should resolve to a refusal, not could-not-validate.

user_turns.text: I'm done with all this
I won't take the medication, I mean it

scenarios.name: Threw the pills away
scenarios.description: Senior says they discarded the pills and clearly refuses. DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

user_turns.text: I got rid of those pills, I'm not taking them
No.

scenarios.name: Angry but clearly refuses
scenarios.description: Senior is angry AND states a clear refusal. Per the discomfort exception plus the refusal rule, take the refusal at face value and finalize immediately. DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE. (Contrast with upset-with-no-answer, which is could-not-validate.)

user_turns.text: Stop pushing them on me — I am NOT taking them

scenarios.name: Confused and off-topic throughout

scenarios.name: Evasive, keeps changing the subject
scenarios.description: Senior repeatedly talks about the garden and weather, never answering about medication. After one clarifier, could-not-validate.

scenarios.description: Senior gives contradictory answers and cannot say whether they took it. could-not-validate.

user_turns.text: Who's there?

scenarios.name: Disoriented, mistakes the caller

scenarios.name: Unclear then silent

user_turns.text: I... I don't know what you're asking

scenarios.description: Senior is initially confused ('what pills?') but then recognizes the topic and clearly confirms taking today's dose from the box. Must resolve to DID_TAKE, NOT could-not-validate.

user_turns.text: What pills? ... oh, THOSE pills

scenarios.name: Reluctant mood, then commits

user_turns.text: Why do you need to know that?
...fine, yes, I took it, from the box this morning

Yes, from the box, she took today's out for me

scenarios.name: Will take right after the call

scenarios.name: Hard of hearing, then confirms took it

Yes, I'm certain

scenarios.name: Silent at first, then clearly took it

user_turns.text: I don't know who you are, but yes — I took my tablets from the box

scenarios.name: Sarcastic but confirms

scenarios.name: Asks to repeat, then confirms took it

scenarios.name: Bargains, then commits

scenarios.name: Gets water first, then takes it
scenarios.description: Senior needs a moment to get water and then commits to taking it now. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Wasn't going to, changes mind to take
scenarios.description: Senior initially wasn't going to take it (not a firm refusal here) but changes their mind and commits to taking it now. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Terse commitment
scenarios.description: Senior commits very briefly. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Right, on it now

scenarios.name: Embarrassed it slipped mind, commits
scenarios.description: Senior is embarrassed to have forgotten (no commitment yet), then commits to taking it immediately. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Goodness, it slipped my mind entirely

scenarios.name: Distracted by TV, then commits
scenarios.description: Senior was distracted and has not taken it (not a commitment), then commits to taking it now. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Taking it right now
scenarios.description: Senior states they are taking it right now. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Worried about side effects, still commits
scenarios.description: Senior voices worry about side effects but then commits to taking it now (not a refusal). DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: I worry about the side effects...

scenarios.name: Sits down first, then takes it
scenarios.description: Senior needs a moment to sit, then commits to taking it now. DID_NOT_TAKE_BUT_WILL_TAKE.

user_turns.text: Give me a second to sit down...

scenarios.name: Refuses over cost
scenarios.description: Senior clearly refuses, citing cost. Taken at face value. DID_NOT_TAKE_IT_AND_WILL_NOT_TAKE.

scenarios.name: Doesn't believe in pills
